instruction: Process this camera RAW file and save it as Adobe RGB JPEG.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because there is no camera RAW file to process - 'yicun.raw' is already a processed JPEG (with Exif standard TIFF data). The file has already been converted from whatever camera RAW format it originated from (if any) to JPEG with specific color space decisions baked in. The task asks to process a RAW file, but GIMP opens this as a JPEG. Additionally, converting from an already-processed JPEG to 'Adobe RGB JPEG' doesn't constitute RAW processing, and the source may not even contain Adobe RGB color space information.
